title: Fast food and obesity

datasets.label: Obesity and fast food by state (CDC + Census, annual)
datasets.credit: Sources: CDC BRFSS (obesity); U.S. Census Bureau, County Business Patterns (restaurants)

sources.name: CDC, Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS)
sources.license: U.S. Government work, public domain (17 USC 105). CDC asks that BRFSS be cited and notes the values are self-reported survey estimates.

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau, County Business Patterns (CBP)
sources.license: U.S. Government work, public domain (17 USC 105). The Census Bureau asks that CBP be cited; small cells are withheld for disclosure avoidance.

datasets.method: Obesity from the CDC DNPAO BRFSS extract (question: percent of adults 18+ with obesity, Total stratification). Restaurants from CBP NAICS 722513, queried at state level so disclosure suppression -- which removes hundreds of counties a year with no flag -- does not silently undercount. 722211 became 722513 in 2012 and is bridged as a code change, not a break.

derivations.method: this year's establishment count minus 2011's, floored at zero
establishment count divided by resident population, times 100,000

breaks.what: BRFSS added cell-phone households and changed its weighting; CDC states that estimates from 2011 forward cannot be compared with earlier ones.
County Business Patterns moved from SIC to NAICS. SIC 5812 'Eating Places' covers full-service and fast food together; the limited-service class (722513) does not exist before NAICS.
